---
name: QA nonconformance
about: A Quality Assurance finding that a defined process was not followed (SUP.1)
labels: type:qa-nonconformance, state:proposed

<!-- See process/processes/SUP.1-quality-assurance.md. Filed BY QA, not by
     the role being audited — process-model.md §3's independence rule. This
     is a PROCESS-conformance finding, never a product-correctness one (see
     process-model.md §2's distinction table) — if this is actually a
     product defect, use Problem report instead. -->

**Process audited** <!-- e.g. SWE.4, SUP.8 — link processes/<id>-*.md -->

**Task/evidence expected** <!-- quote the specific Task from the process file -->

**What was found instead** <!-- CONFIRMED / NOT FOUND / PARTIAL, with the exact evidence checked -->

**Cross-filed risk** <!-- link the process/risk-register.md entry — every
     nonconformance is filed there the same day, per SUP.1's own Task 5 -->

**Disposition** <!-- Project Management's response, once triaged -->
